Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 102: November 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #102 shipped to subscribers in October 2009 (bearing the cover date of November 2009 for Issue 102). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #102 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

Left 4 Dead 2 (co-op first-person survival horror)
James Cameron's Avatar: The Game (third-person action-adventure)
MX vs. ATV Reflex (off-road racing)
Fairytale Fights (hack-and-slash action-adventure)
Wallace & Gromit's Grand Adventures (Xbox Live Arcade episodic graphic adventure)
NBA Unchained (Xbox Live Arcade sports action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Mass Effect 2, Splinter Cell: Conviction, and BioShock 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
